Our Story

About BHI

Built on trust, craftsmanship, and an uncompromising commitment to New York's property owners.

30+ Years NYC Experience
Who We Are

Trusted by New York's
Property Owners

BHI Building Services was founded on a simple principle: New York property owners deserve a reliable service partner they can count on—one that responds promptly, communicates clearly, delivers exceptional workmanship, and stands behind every project. From day one, we've built our reputation through quality craftsmanship, dependable service, and long-term relationships. Rather than relying on sales pitches, we've earned the trust of homeowners, landlords, condominium and cooperative boards, and property management companies by consistently delivering results on time and within budget. Today, BHI Building Services provides comprehensive building maintenance, repair, renovation, and property improvement solutions throughout New York City. Whether it's a single apartment turnover, a complete interior renovation, emergency repairs, or ongoing maintenance for an entire portfolio of properties, our experienced team is committed to keeping buildings operating safely, efficiently, and at their best.

Why Choose BHI Building Services?

  • Fully licensed and insured throughout New York City
  • Honest, transparent estimates with no hidden fees
  • Comprehensive residential and commercial building services
  • Customized recurring maintenance programs
  • Fast response for emergency repairs and service requests
  • Trusted by property owners, investors, and professional property management companies
  • Backed by more than 30 years of combined New York City property maintenance, renovation, and building operations experience

At BHI Building Services, we don't just maintain properties—we protect investments, enhance property value, and provide dependable solutions our clients can rely on year after year.

How We Operate

Our Core
Values

Integrity & Transparency

We operate with full transparency on pricing, scope, and timelines. Every estimate is honest, every invoice is expected. Our clients never encounter surprise charges or unexpected changes.

Quality Craftsmanship

We hold every project to a standard we'd be proud to put our name on. Materials are selected for durability, work is executed with precision, and we don't consider a job complete until it meets our own quality benchmark.

Dependable Service

We show up when we say we will, communicate proactively throughout each project, and remain accessible to our clients from first consultation through final walkthrough. Reliability is a core part of what we deliver.
